title: Post-9/11 GI Bill Monthly Housing Allowance - Rule and Computation
content:
**Education Procedures, Part 3 — Monthly housing allowance (Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education)).**

**3.01 Threshold.** The Post-9/11 GI Bill monthly housing allowance is paid to the student only when the rate of pursuit is greater than 50 percent. At exactly 50 percent nothing is paid; above 50 percent the allowance is computed under 3.02.

**3.02 Amount for a month of training.** For a month of training the allowance equals the campus housing rate on the certification — or the distance-learning monthly figure when every course is distance learning, or the foreign-school monthly figure at a foreign school — multiplied by the benefit level of the tier, multiplied by the rate of pursuit expressed as a fraction of full time and rounded to the nearest tenth, multiplied by the days of the month inside the term and divided by a 30-day month, the product kept to the cent. Nothing is paid for days between terms.

**3.03 Release.** A housing payment for a month is released only after the student has verified enrollment for that month. The evidence is the system's record of a verification entry for the same certification and the same month as the payment.

**3.04 Worked illustration (hypothetical inputs).** Campus housing rate $2400.00; 80% Benefit Level; rate of pursuit 67 percent; 20 days of the month inside the term.
- 67 percent rounded to the nearest tenth is 0.7.
- $2400.00 multiplied by 0.8 is $1920.00; multiplied by 0.7 is $1344.00.
- $1344.00 multiplied by 20 and divided by 30 is $896.00.

**3.05 Boundary cases (hypothetical).**

| Rate of pursuit | Above 50 percent | Fraction used |
|---|---|---|
| 50 percent | No — nothing paid | — |
| 51 percent | Yes | 0.5 |
| 74 percent | Yes | 0.7 |
| 76 percent | Yes | 0.8 |
| 100 percent | Yes | 1.0 |

**3.06 Basis Q&A.**
*Is the allowance paid for a month that has not been verified?* Not under 3.03; the release waits on the verification entry for that certification and month.
*Is a full calendar month of 31 days paid as 31 days?* A full month counts as 30 days in the division under 3.02.
